teaser: Some people carry the first-aid kit without being asked. That is the shape of life path 6, and ESTP is the type built for the moment right after someone trips, not the moment before when worry would normally start. Cross the two and the caretaking in you arrives as action first, feeling later, the arm already out before the sentence "are you okay" finishes. This number leans toward devotion to the people nearby; these letters supply speed instead of hovering. What is particular here is a softness that moves fast, a kind of care that looks like reflex and gets mistaken for not caring at all.
excerpt: Three exits missed because the talk got real around some mile marker, neither one pulling off to finish it properly, is a familiar scene you know from a rental car on a highway.
